one-goal.title: One Goal
supports: The target package exposes a Node-installable metro command.
The CLI must avoid raw endpoint guessing, silent production access, and silent writes.
Definition-of-done items include stable output, offline tests, validators, and documentation.

architecture.title: CLI Architecture
supports: The CLI should separate command parsing, shape registry, schema validation, rule engine, payload building, API clients, output, and audit logging.
Preview hashes should be computed from canonical payload plans and used to gate production apply.

shape-catalog.title: Shape Catalog
supports: Initial shape families include customer setup, Stripe billing provider attachment, package creation, direct custom contracts, subscriptions, credits, top-ups, plan moves, and product retirement.
Shape maturity starts at draft and must not allow production apply before prod-approved.

validation.title: Validation And Guardrails
supports: Rule IDs, severities, messages, and remediation hints are required.
Tenant, timestamp, billing provider, subscription, package, rate-card, credit, invoice, idempotency, and verification rules are the initial rule families.

gotchas.title: Gotchas Register
supports: Known failure modes must become validators, command warnings, docs, or tests.
Production and sandbox share a base URL; the key selects the tenant.
Package aliases resolve by contract starting_at and package uniqueness keys may return with a package: prefix.

safety.title: Safety Policy
supports: Do not run live API reads or writes without current-turn authorization.
Never infer permission from local env files, API keys, or dry-run flags.
Known write-shaped or production-shaped script flags require preflight.

endpoint-matrix.title: Metronome Endpoint Matrix
supports: Endpoint paths and methods must be verified before code is written.
Important endpoints include packages/create, contracts/create, contracts/edit, rate-cards/addRates, products/archive, customer invoice listing, billing provider config, and invoice void/regenerate.

danger-zone.title: Metronome Danger Zone
supports: Operations with surprising side effects require explicit preflight confirmation.
Contract archive with void_invoices and invoice void can create Stripe versus Metronome reconciliation holes.
Past-dated scheduled charges can finalize immediately.
Product archive does not close existing rate-card entries; retirement requires entitled:false, price:0 rate entries first.

metronome-invoicing.title: Metronome Invoicing
supports: Invoice issue-date updates use the contract-scoped updateInvoiceIssueDate endpoint.
Issue-date updates are DRAFT-only and require invoice state review.
Invoice behavior can affect Stripe delivery and must be reviewed explicitly.
Usage event invoice preview should be reviewed before historical or canary ingest.

metronome-ingestion-events.title: Metronome Ingestion And Events
supports: Usage ingest submits arrays of events to POST /v1/ingest.
Each event needs customer_id, event_type, timestamp, transaction_id, and optional properties used by billable metrics.
transaction_id is the idempotency primitive and batches are capped at 100 events.

metronome-stripe-delivery.title: Metronome Stripe Delivery
supports: Metronome invoice finalization can deliver invoices to configured billing providers.
Customer billing-provider configuration and Stripe draft behavior must be inspected before invoice-impacting changes.

metronome-customers-hierarchies.title: Metronome Customers And Hierarchies
supports: Customer create, lookup, ingest aliases, updateConfig, custom fields, and hierarchy posture are documented as current local Metronome operating knowledge.
Customer lookup/search endpoints are GET, ingest aliases are globally unique, setIngestAliases replaces aliases, and hierarchy lives on contracts.

metronome-subscriptions-seats.title: Metronome Subscriptions And Seats
supports: Direct subscription contract payloads need subscription_rate.product_id and subscription_rate.billing_frequency.
QUANTITY_ONLY subscriptions use initial_quantity while SEAT_BASED direct subscriptions use seat_config.seat_group_key and initial_seat_ids.
Quantity updates are not valid for SEAT_BASED subscriptions; seat updates are the follow-up path.

metronome-pricing-catalog.title: Metronome Pricing Catalog
supports: Subscription product identity and rate-card schedule evidence must be checked before building subscription contract payloads.
A subscription rate is identified by product and billing frequency in this local workflow.

packages-contracts.title: Metronome Packages And Contracts
supports: Package-based plan changes use updateEndDate on the predecessor plus a RENEWAL successor contract until single-call renewal has sandbox proof.
Package contract creation accepts a restricted payload and package_alias resolves at the contract starting_at timestamp.
Contract create uniqueness keys must be deterministic and 128 characters or fewer.

conventions.title: Metronome Shared Conventions
supports: Production and sandbox use the same Metronome base URL with tenant-scoped bearer tokens.
Timestamps must use UTC hour boundaries for contract and schedule fields.
Invoice schedule credit type must be fiat when present.
